resources.string: Enter size 1–1024, opacity/hardness 0–100 and a valid hex color.

Open a project folder or .comp.zip archive to inspect its composite or a source layer. Eligible raster layers support temporary chunked brush edits with undo and redo. Save an edited .comp.zip copy to keep those edits; the selected source stays unchanged.
